repos:
  - repo: https://github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks
    rev: v8.18.4
    hooks:
      - id: gitleaks
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: format-code
        name: format-code
        entry: ./scripts/format.sh
        language: script
        pass_filenames: false
  - repo: local
    hooks:
      - id: lint-code
        name: lint-code
        entry: ./scripts/lint.sh
        language: script
        pass_filenames: false

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e
set -x

pnpm run format

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e
set -x

pnpm run lint
pnpm run typecheck

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e
set -x

pnpm run test:coverage
